payload.title: Rename Anth.us repos: Anth.us-Papyrus to Anth.us-web (public), Anth.us to Anth.us-legacy-Gatsby, with Papyrus notice
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-10-17: pay off naming debt. (1) Rename AnthusAI/Anth.us-Papyrus to AnthusAI/Anth.us-web and make it public. (2) Rename AnthusAI/Anth.us to AnthusAI/Anth.us-legacy-Gatsby. (3) Add a clear notice to the legacy repo (README, AGENTS) that anth.us is powered by Papyrus and served from Anth.us-web. (4) Update old repo names in docs and Kanbus boards (PPY-736021, PPY-b488da, PPY-44a215 etc.). Blocker before going public: Anth.us-Papyrus history has no credentials but contains AWS account IDs (712236451410, 830955873957, 335163751677), a CloudFront ARN, a deploy-role ARN and an old AppSync/Amplify domain; Ryan to decide publish as-is vs scrub history. Also verify the Amplify app GitHub connection and CI (anthus-site-content, PPY-b488da) survive the rename; any AWS/Amplify change runs on Ryan's Mac. GitHub redirects old names, but git remotes and workflow references should be updated.
